en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional; the second version is marked with the source's own line '(Друга верзија)', copied unchanged. 'џам везир' / 'џамли Веза' is unclear to me (rendered '...'), and the sense of 'на големо' ('rise up high') is my reading.

words_to_learn.en: estate, farm held by an agha
high, in a big way (my reading)

lines.en: Adem Agha comes from below,

lines.cyr: право ми трга на чифликот, ајде.
lines.lat: pravo mi trga na čiflikot, ajde.
lines.en: he heads straight for the estate, come on.
When the estate-workers saw him,

lines.cyr: сите на нога му станаа, ајде.
lines.lat: site na noga mu stanaa, ajde.
lines.en: they all stood up for him, come on.

lines.cyr: Само џам везирот не му стана,
lines.lat: Samo džam vezirot ne mu stana,
lines.en: Only the ... vizier did not stand up,
Adem Agha grew angry, come on.
- Oh ... vizier, ... vizier,

lines.cyr: кога ќе дојди лето пролето, ајде.
lines.lat: koga ḱe dojdi leto proleto, ajde.
lines.en: when summer and spring come, come on,
I will become an outlaw,

lines.cyr: ќе ти ги пленам твоите браќа.
lines.lat: ḱe ti gi plenam tvoite braḱa.
lines.en: I will plunder your brothers.

lines.cyr: Ти ќе ме молиш на колено,
lines.lat: Ti ḱe me moliš na koleno,
lines.en: You will beg me on your knee,

lines.cyr: јас ќе се кревам на големо, ајде.
lines.lat: jas ḱe se krevam na golemo, ajde.
lines.en: and I will rise up high, come on.
Adem Agha comes from below,
he heads straight for the estate.
All the estate-workers saw him,
they all stood up for him.
Only ... Veza did not stand up:
- All the estate-workers stood up for me,
only you did not stand.

lines.cyr: Дали знаеш Везо, ил не знаеш?
lines.lat: Dali znaeš Vezo, il ne znaeš?
lines.en: Do you know, Veza, or don't you know?
For summer and spring will come,
I will become an outlaw,
an outlaw, a fierce snake in the mountain,

lines.cyr: и ќе ги вана Везо твојте браќа.
lines.lat: i ḱe gi vana Vezo tvojte braḱa.
lines.en: and I will catch your brothers, Veza.
Your brothers, Veza, two twins.

lines.cyr: Ти ќе ми дојдеш Везо на молење,
lines.lat: Ti ḱe mi dojdeš Vezo na molenje,
lines.en: You will come to me, Veza, begging,

lines.cyr: а ја ќе се крена на големо.
lines.lat: a ja ḱe se krena na golemo.
lines.en: and I will rise up high.

lines.cyr: Ја ќе се крена, Везо, на големо,
lines.lat: Ja ḱe se krena, Vezo, na golemo,
lines.en: I will rise up high, Veza,

lines.cyr: дур' не ми седниш на колено.
lines.lat: dur' ne mi sedniš na koleno.
lines.en: until you sit on my knee.
